json.title: Send blocked - alternate screen mode

plain_lines: Error: Send blocked - alternate screen mode
Policy violation: send blocked: redaction policy denies destructive command
The send action was blocked because the pane is in alternate screen mode. This typically means a full-screen application like vim, less, or htop is running.
• Review policy configuration or request approval if needed.
• Check ft.toml policy settings for explicit allow rules.
Run `ft why FT-4001` for more details.
